body:
Avery: Quick sync — Azure Marketplace asking for SOC2 report + latest external pen-test artifacts. They need a redacted bundle and an upload link by EOD Friday. Who can own redaction and the upload?
Priya: I can triage the PII/credentials scope. Do we have a canonical redaction checklist? :thinking_face:
Marco: We have a draft in /confluence/security/marketplace-redaction but it's outdated. Quick reminder: remove customer names, IPs, API keys, and anything that maps to identifiable tenants.
Ellie: I can own the upload flow. Plan: 1) Security to mark redaction items 2) Platform to produce presigned S3 link with limited TTL 3) Partnerships to submit bundle to marketplace portal. OK? :+1:
Priya: That workflow works. For pen-test output, ask the vendor for a "vendor-redacted" copy first. If they won't, we can redact before upload but need vendor signoff.
Avery: Timeline: today redaction scope, tomorrow vendor follow-up, Thursday finalize bundle, Friday upload. Does that meet Azure's EOD request?
Marco: One more: include a manifest.txt with filenames and redaction tags (PII, creds, configs). Example manifest line: `2024-11-05_s3_presigned_manifest.json — auth-logs (PII redacted)`
Ellie: For the presigned link, I'll request a 48h TTL and limit to our partnership-bucket/marketplace-evidence/<deal-id> path. Also enable object ACL = private.
SecurityBot: Reminder: retention policy requires us to remove marketplace artifacts after 90 days unless legal requests extension. See policy: https://redwood.internal/security/policies/evidence-retention
Priya: Redaction checklist (short):
```
- Remove/obfuscate usernames, emails, tenant IDs
- Strip or truncate IP addresses (keep class if needed)
- Remove API keys, tokens, SSH host keys
- Replace customer-specific S3/bucket names with PLACEHOLDER
- Ensure vendor PII sections are redacted and vendor signed off
```
Avery: Good. Who'll make the actual edits to the docs (search-and-replace)? Our SOC report is a PDF — do we have a redaction tool?
Marco: We have Adobe redaction licensed under SecOps. I'll run the SOC PDF through it and produce a redacted stamped copy.
Ellie: I'll open a TODO in partnerships repo for the upload steps and attach the presigned link once ready. Will @Avery and @Priya get a notification for review?
Avery: Yes please. Priya to confirm PII removed, Marco to confirm technical redaction, then Ellie submits.
Priya: One nuance: pen-test findings sometimes reference internal endpoints. Mark those as INTERNAL-ENDPOINT and confirm no customer-hosted endpoints are leaked.
Ellie: Noted. I'll also attach a short README with contact info and redaction summary for the marketplace reviewer.
Avery: OK — action owners: Marco (SOC redaction), Priya (PII signoff + vendor coordination), Ellie (upload + manifest). I'll ping legal if vendor signoff steps need a template.
SecurityBot: Automating evidence TTL: presigned links will be invalidated after upload TTL and we will schedule object delete at day+90.
Marco: I'll start redaction now and post progress. ETA for initial redacted SOC PDF: 16:00 today PST.
Priya: I'll draft vendor email asking for a vendor-redacted pen-test and consent to share. Posting draft in thread in 20m.
Ellie: Thanks. If anyone needs the bucket path: partnership-bucket/marketplace-evidence/azure-listings/2024-Q4/<deal-id>. Keep me posted. :rocket:
Avery: Perfect. We'll re-sync here after Marco's SOC drop. Thanks everyone.
